properties.name: service.bridge.request-topic
properties.description: REQUEST topic shared by Client and Server.

properties.name: service.bridge.request-topics
properties.description: Business type to REQUEST topic mapping. When configured, only listed business types are accepted.

properties.name: service.bridge.response-topic
properties.description: RESPONSE topic shared by Client and Server.

properties.name: service.bridge.client.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time an HTTP request waits for a result.

properties.name: service.bridge.client.max-waiting-requests
properties.description: Maximum in-memory waiting requests per instance.

properties.name: service.bridge.client.reconciliation-enabled
properties.description: Periodically reconcile waiting requests with database terminal results. Disabled by default.
